name: Auto Job Apply
description: Generate tailored resumes and (later) autofill job applications using your local Claude Code CLI.

generate-json.description: Generate JSON (or Copy prompt for GPT)

generate-pdf.description: Generate PDF - suggest Alt+P in chrome://extensions/shortcuts

save-sample.description: Save Sample - suggest Alt+S in chrome://extensions/shortcuts

attach-resume.description: Attach Resume to Form - suggest Alt+R in chrome://extensions/shortcuts

portal-sync.description: Save & Sync to Portal - suggest Alt+Y in chrome://extensions/shortcuts
